column2: Expert grenade throwers that carry a range of different grenade types. Most effective against slow moving or suppressed targets, up to medium armor.
Versatile infantry squad that can deploy various support weapons to augment its firepower and adopt to various battlefield conditions.
Constructable field radio that allows you to request new units and reinforcements
Support unit that can construct field radio stations and has various fire support abilities.
This deforestation machine can serve as a sturdy front-line defense. It excells against unarmored enemies and has the ability to suppress larger numbers.
This light weapon platform mounts a medium mortar to provide indirect fire support against lightly armored ground targets. It can also fire special air-burst rounds against airborne targets.

Custom built biped with 4 recoilless rifles mounted on its turret. This gives the biped excellent performance against heavily armored targets, but with a low rate of fire and vulnerability to taking hits.
Highly mobile weapon system that excells at destroying heavily armored targets from a safe distance, but with a low rate of fire and vulnerability to taking hits.
This biped mounts a dual howitzers to provide powerful indirect fire support. It excels at destroying enemies from long range.
The most advanced biped in the M.I's arsenal. It relies mostly on its speed and firepower to defeat its enemies, but also has a decent level of armor protection.
This elite trooper wears an advanced powered armor suit that offers excellent protection and mobility. The weapon has a very long range with good armor piercing capabilities but a slow rate of fire.
Cheap defensive structure holding a heavy machine gun and a few troopers equipped with assault rifles and grenades.
Due to the blast radius these grenades cannot be used in point blank range. Ideally construct these structures so they can provide mutual fire support.
This armored personnel carrier can reinforce squads or deploy additional infantry units. It also has its own escort of troopers wearing Fortis powered armor suits.
Call in a drone that can be used to spray an area with burning thermite.
Eject the saw blade at high RPM causing it to launch forward and deal damage to anything it passes through.
Increase the armor of the SawMaster
Call in a TAC Fighter to drop Phosphorus bombs at the target location.
Deploy a string of air-dropped defensive turrets to form a defensive perimeter.
Temporarily deploy a machine gun to provide direct fire support.
Temporarily deploy a mortar to provide indirect fire support.
Temporarily deploy an infiltrator on the target location. This elite sniper unit can't move but cannot be detected by the enemy.
The pyrotechnic effect of this device attracts Bugs. The consecutive detonation is not lethal but does have a strong suppressive effect.
Creates a strong suppression effect all around the SawMaster.
Call in an accurate artillery strike originating from the main base of operations.
Fire a drone that releases Napalm beneath it! This drone explodes on death
Fire a drone that greatly increases LOS and will boost damage inflicted on the enemies it hovers over! This drone explodes on death
Deploy the M23-T making it possible to request and reinforce units
Undeploy the M23-T giving back mobility
Rescue the survivors and clear the hives
Welcome to the jungle, Commander. We have dropships down in Bug country - find the survivors and bring them home.
Survivors are home and the hives are ash. Outstanding work - the only good Bug is a dead Bug.
One group of survivors has been rescued. Good work, commander!
Only one group of survivors remaining, commander!
All groups of survivors have been rescued!
